blurb: Guests visit the vineyard and tasting room to enjoy a variety of wines including library wines, white wines like Chardonnay and Sauvignon Blanc blends, red blends, and the KickAss wine line. The estate vineyard is dry-farmed and located in the Templeton Gap AVA near Paso Robles. The tasting room offers wine tasting and a bistro with gourmet foods for purchase.
